text:
maya (prod): OKR draft uploaded — quick sync. PTAL: https://redwood.internal/okrs/drafts/2026-q3

maya (prod): Key ask: sign off on company-level commitment to 'Predictable Latency 99th <= 250ms' and prioritized budget for Dedicated capacity pilot.

tom (eng): quick read. are we locking quantization efforts into this quarter to hit that latency target?

maya (prod): yes — Optimize work (quant + batching) is prioritized. but we need to decide on scope of Dedicated pilot (10 customers vs 3 strategic).

raj (growth): from customer signals — 3 strategic customers will buy reserved capacity now, but 10 gives faster MRR ramp. tradeoff on engineering effort.

sarah (cto): can we run a smaller pilot (3) with a cadence to expand to 10 if SLOs met? need rollout gate and clear metrics.

emily (design): launch criteria proposal in doc: SLOs met for 72h under synthetic load, first customer on-boarding story completed, docs + runbook >= 80% coverage.

maya (prod): proposed gate: "canary -> 3-customer pilot -> 10-customer expand". if latency regression >10% revert.

tom (eng): on revert policy — suggest automated fallback to hosted variant and auto-notify customers. adds ~2 wks dev.

maya (prod): noted. do we accept the 2wk dev cost in Q3 scope?

raj (growth): yes if we assume conservative 6-month payback — sales says pipeline justifies it.

sarah (cto): approve conditional on clear rollback automation and an on-call runbook.

maya (prod): action items I: tom to size rollback + fallback work (ETA Wed). II: emily to finalize launch criteria checklist. III: raj to confirm pilot customer list by Fri.

lia-bot: Reminder: please add your vote on the OKR doc reactions by EOD.

tom (eng): sizing note: fallback requires a short proxy layer and a config flag. estimate 8 dev-days + tests.

emily (design): checklist updated with onboarding step and sample prompts. pushed to doc.

raj (growth): sending customer list now — pinging legal for contracts for 3 customers.

maya (prod): thanks. last call: any objections to marking the company OKR as 'committed' for Q3?

sarah (cto): +1 conditional (see rollback).

tom (eng): +1 but we should track a separate risk ticket for quant regressions.

emily (design): +1

raj (growth): +1

maya (prod): great — I'll mark committed and add the action items. will post a follow-up with timelines. :thumbsup:

lia-bot: OKR status changed to Committed by maya (prod)

maya (prod): thanks all — appreciate quick responses. if anything urgent DM me.

emily (design): small ask: can we schedule a 30m handoff doc review with eng next week?

tom (eng): yes — suggest Tue 11am, calendar invite to follow.

maya (prod): meeting scheduled. closing thread.
